scope: Five implemented opening mode groups: limit (including Post Only/IOC/Hidden/BBO), market (including quick), conditional limit (STOP/TAKE_PROFIT), conditional market (STOP_MARKET/TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET), trailing. Direction, optional protection and entry pricing do not create independent preferences.

New/missing preferences require confirmation. Preserve existing vanta.confirmMarketOrders choice; newly supported modes do not inherit a prior market opt-out. Choices are local to this installation, not exchange permissions or wallet-specific settings.

Explicit toggle enables/disables current mode; each dialog begins with Do not show again unchecked. Cancel/dismiss does not save. Confirm+checked saves current mode only; no selection carries across dialogs or types.

Limit and Post Only share one provider/storage key. Main ordinary market and chart quick entry share exactly the same provider/storage key. Attached opening TP/SL follows the parent opening mode, as specified.

Explicit disabled/loaded/error-free preference skips app review only; wallet signing, fresh context/identity/rules checks, frozen base quantity/ID, pending journal and unknown-result recovery remain existing controller/repository responsibilities. Button label changes from review to signing/submission accordingly.

Read/write/loading failures cannot silently skip review. The last persisted value remains displayed, with a localized error and required review until a successful choice is saved. Already explicitly confirmed current intent may submit once after a preference-save failure, subject to existing revalidation.
Writes are serialized per mode; old read/saves do not overwrite more recent explicit choice. Different modes do not block one another; disposed controllers discard late state updates.

Identity changed while app review is open prevents saving or submitting that captured review. Saving may take time; existing original-intent/context revision checks reject stale or changed contexts afterward.

Dedicated reducing/entire-position close keeps its independent required review. Scaled keeps dedicated confirmation without Do not show again. Unimplemented Chase and user-deferred TWAP have no new preferences or submit flows in this increment.

Dialogs resolve localization inside builder, so language changes update already-open labels while preserving checkbox and captured intent. New text uses EN/ZH ARB and semantic theme defaults; no new dependency.

This increment does not complete Scaled quote amount/distribution/first-visit defaults, first navigation/default account audit, custom-slippage execution contract, full strategy management, Portfolio/Swap or Chase recovery. No real account or native acceptance performed.
